name: Balinka (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and black triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Balinka (a quartered shield of blue and red with crossed hammers, a tree and a flower, within a wreath) between the dates 1193–2000 above and the name BALINKA below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and black triangles
